highlights.title: TETHYS gets its own panel
highlights.description: TETHYS Wetness now sits next to GAIA Water Flow with its own logo: fabric, Bake Wetness and the wet look up front, everything technical folded away.

highlights.title: Clearer GAIA Water Flow
highlights.description: Source, domain and the fluid cache status with Prepare Fluid Cache come first; cache settings are folded away, and Wet Fabric Physics says what it does.

highlights.title: Look changes are instant
highlights.description: Wetness, Darkening, Wet Roughness and Drop Relief update the material at once, without baking again.
